name: Strengths And Weaknesses
overview: Scripture reveals that our strengths and weaknesses are understood and transformed through the truth and power of God’s Word, which discerns the intentions of the heart and brings freedom (John 8:32; Hebrews 4:12). Believers are empowered to overcome challenges through Christ who strengthens them beyond their own ability (Philippians 4:13; Ephesians 3:20). When wisdom or strength is lacking, God generously provides what is needed to persevere (James 1:5), and the lessons recorded in Scripture offer patience and hope to sustain us in our journey (Romans 15:4).
